messages:
maria: noticing spike in etcd compaction activity in us-west1 around 00:10 UTC, kube-apiserver started returning 503s and GPU pods stalled in Pending for several minutes. looks like leader churn.
aj: any crashloop or OOMs on etcd pods?
maria: yes, etcd-us-west1-1 OOMKilled then restarted; others stayed up. `kubectl -n kube-system get sts etcd-us-west1` shows 1/3 with issues.
henry: apiserver metrics show `etcd_request_duration_seconds` tail latency jump and controller-manager backed off with many requeues. GPU scheduling backlog peaked ~90 pods.
infra-ops: we triggered a nightly etcd snapshot job at 00:08 UTC across regions. could be correlated.
leah: snapshot + compaction on same instance can blow memory if compactor runs and snapshot streams concurrently. can we pause the snapshots immediately?
aj: pausing the infra snapshot cronjob now: ```kubectl -n infra patch cronjob infra-etcd-snap -p '{"spec":{"suspend":true}}'``` — done.
maria: confirmed job suspended. etcd-us-west1-1 still restarting; logs show compactor process OOM just before leader change.
henry: quick mitigations:
- temporarily increase etcd pod memory limit on failing replica
- scale controller-manager to reduce retry pressure
- keep snapshot suspended and schedule to off-peak with jitter
leah: agree. ops okay with temporary memory bump for up to 4 hours? will increase reserved cost but avoids wider outage.
aj: ops approved for temporary bump. applying resources: requests=4Gi, limits=6Gi on etcd-us-west1-1, then restart that member only.
maria: commands used:
```
# patch statefulset for mem bump
kubectl -n kube-system patch sts etcd-us-west1 --type=json -p '[{"op":"replace","path":"/spec/template/spec/containers/0/resources/requests/memory","value":"4Gi"},{"op":"replace","path":"/spec/template/spec/containers/0/resources/limits/memory","value":"6Gi"}]'
# restart single replica
kubectl -n kube-system rollout restart sts etcd-us-west1 --selector=statefulset.kubernetes.io/pod-name=etcd-us-west1-1
```
henry: apiserver 503s dropped from ~15% to ~1.5% within 4 minutes, scheduling backlog down to 10 pods. good signal.
leah: next steps:
- keep snapshot suspended until we modify cron to add `--bandwidth-throttle` and randomized start window
- add etcd compactor memory usage alert at 70% to preempt this
- run staging stress test simulating snapshots + compaction
- longer term: spin up read-only etcd replica cluster for snapshots to avoid hitting control-plane members
infra-ops: will update cronjob to add throttling and jitter and re-enable at 01:30 UTC off-peak.
aj: creating TASK-10021 to revert mem bump after 4h and TASK-10022 to add alerts and test plan.
sre-bot: incident created: INC-2026-4189 (us-west1-etcd-compaction-snapshot-conflict)
deploy-bot: TASK-10021 scheduled — revert etcd mem bump at 1913490989
maria: verified cluster health, member list stable, leader steady. marking incident as monitoring. thanks everyone :thumbsup:
